message: 決戦前夜
The day before the Holy Night Festival.

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Blackout curtains, blackout curtains, we need more!」

name: Yumil
message: 「Coming through with the delivery! Out of the way, please!」

name: Eddie
message: 「The Baseball Club just keeps on doing practice swings! Behold! My practice swings!」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「In the way, in the way, in the way! Baseball Club over there, you're in the way!」

name: Eddie
message: 「You dare call my sacred practice swings an obstruction?!」

name: Yumil
message: 「Both of you are in the way!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Good day to you all.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh! Refreshments, right?! Gimme!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hardly any time has passed since you brought us refreshments earlier, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. It's already three o'clock.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat?!」

name: Misa
message: 「When did it get so late.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Just so. Nothing good comes of pushing yourselves too hard, after all. Won't you take a little breather right about now?」

name: Ria
message: 「Then I'll put on some tea.」

name: Sally
message: 「Refreshments, refreshments! Yay.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You haven't even been working.」

name: Sally
message: 「Just having me around makes the atmosphere better!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What are you, a deodorizer.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, I suppose we need only set the sweets in front of Sally-chan. So long as she can enjoy the atmosphere, that's plenty.」

name: Sally
message: 「No way, not just the atmosphere!」

name: Sally
message: 「What's the big deal! The angels haven't even been here since this morning!」

name: Synn
message: 「I have them working on a job that requires that.」
Lolotte, Amyrina, and Melilot-san are undoing the magic circles around the academy.

name: Sally
message: 「Boo-hoo, I wanna have a job where I just hang around outside too! Actually, I'm totally gonna do that!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now don't ya go gettin' all worked up like that. Have yourself some rakugan and calm your nerves a bit.」

name: Sally
message: 「Munch, munch. Yum! Pure bliss!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grrr... eating Japanese sweets with such a happy look on her face... she's been completely brainwashed.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sally, you eat both kinds anyway, don't you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why doesn't anyone ever bring sweets as a treat?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Maybe you've got a problem with your choice of friends?」

name: Synn
message: 「Speak of the devil.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「My friend! Thanks for the treats!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「What are you talking about--?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I was a fool to get my hopes up...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh, right, right--. I almost forgot--. Big trouble--. Big trouble--」

name: Misa
message: 「When you say it like that, it doesn't sound like big trouble at all.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Waaah. Nobody believes me--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Quit the fake crying. So, what happened that's 'big trouble'?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「There was a multi-cart pileup at the entrance--, and three handcarts broke--, and now there aren't enough spares so everyone's fighting over them--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That IS big trouble!」

name: Misa
message: 「Everyone's overloading those carts way too much! Nobody's following the weight limits, are they?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And then Shio-chan snapped, and started swinging Kogitsunemaru around--」
Everyone is busy.
The only ones with their hands free at this moment are...

name: Sally
message: 「Leave it to me! With this fabulous gas I bought from Demon World Mail-Order, 'Shizukaninaru,' I'll quiet those noisy fools right--」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll go check it out! Misa, hold down the fort here for a bit!」

name: Misa
message: 「Got it.」

name: Sally
message: 「Listen to what I'm saying!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It says 'poison' right on it, doesn't it.」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Everyone, fighting, stop. Fighting, not beautiful. Ode, carrying, help.」
Thanks to Eauderourke, who had come to help, saying that, the commotion had already died down by the time I reached the entrance.
He's strong and leaves quite an impact, in various ways.

name: Shio
message: 「My apologies, Synn-dono. Despite being entrusted with maintaining public morals, I lost my composure. I shall slice open my belly--」

name: Synn
message: 「If you want to take responsibility, do it by seeing your job through to the end.」

name: Shio
message: 「What magnanimous words! I am deeply moved! I shall work myself to the bone!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, don't push yourself too hard, okay.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「That is all. Did you write it down, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nailed it! Here you go, Librarian, all done!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see... hmm, hmm. How intricate... another pattern variation...」
Thinking they looked busy, I was about to turn back when.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, slacking off is no good.」

name: Synn
message: 「I was just a bit curious about your progress.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Leave it to me! It's going great!」

name: Melilot
message: 「We are far from being able to say that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't throw cold water on me right when things are getting good.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I apologize for borrowing people from the busy Student Council.」

name: Synn
message: 「This job is important too. So, how is the progress looking?」

name: Melilot
message: 「We have destroyed nearly three-sevenths of the magic circles on campus, yet just under eighty percent of the overall function still remains.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though you've destroyed that many?」

name: Melilot
message: 「The smaller magic circles are complementing each other's functions, preventing any loss of capability.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「If only Lolotte's spiritual essence were a little denser...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm a secretary, so this is plenty fine for me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Spiritual essence?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「U-Umm, it's what makes up the bodies of us angels. Originally, we're non-material beings--in other words, our bodies are composed of spiritual substance.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, well, we can't operate in the Human World like that, so here we wrap ourselves in physical matter to protect our spiritual substance.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte's been here so long that her spiritual substance has thinned out... so she can't read the seals.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even I'm surprised by it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm the only one handling the dispelling and destruction anyway, so the speed won't change.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Besides, Lolotte-san's handwriting is neat. It's very easy to read and has been a great help.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Those who get it really do get it, don't they.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, the destruction wasn't for nothing. I've nearly grasped the mechanics and structure of these magic circles.」

name: Melilot
message: 「From here on, I will destroy only the magic circles with critical functions to strip them of their power.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Doing this should strip away 90% of their functions before Re-Crea reaches criticality.」

name: Synn
message: 「We're counting on you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That means Azel-san and the President will have tons of time to talk!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Woo her nicely and get her into bed!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-Whaaat!?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Wh-Wh-Wh-What are you saying, Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Anyway, good night.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What good is going to sleep now!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Panda sure is ignorant. Living creatures are supposed to sleep at night.」
Contrary to Lolotte's perfectly reasonable claim.
The day of the Holy Night Festival arrived while the vast majority of the students pulled an all-nighter.
